title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Katoomba, 13-16 May, 2015-2026
claims: For the Scenic World grid point at -33.7288, 150.3005 (model elevation 954 m), the 48 days of 13-16 May across 2015-2026 give daily maximum temperatures from 8.0 to 21.4 C with a median of 14.75 C.
The same 48 days give daily minimum temperatures from -3.4 to 10.8 C with a median of 3.9 C.
Precipitation reaches 1 mm on 10 of 48 days and 5 mm on 2 of 48 days, with a maximum daily total of 15.0 mm.

For a course high-point grid cell at -33.745, 150.315 with elevation set to 1,030 m, the same 48 days give daily maxima from 7.5 to 20.9 C (median 13.9 C) and minima from -2.7 to 10.6 C (median 4.15 C).
At that high-point cell, precipitation reaches 1 mm on 13 of 48 days and 5 mm on 4 of 48 days, with a maximum daily total of 14.9 mm.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 调用 Open-Meteo archive API，取 2015-05-13 至 2026-05-16 的 daily 数据，筛选每年 5 月 13-16 日共 48 天；高程点用 elevation=1030 参数做降尺度
